#FollowLASTMA

STONEWALL PHILIPPINES 2025 🏳️‍🌈✊

LOOK: LGBTQ+ rights group Bahaghari led the commemoration of the 31st anniversary of "Stonewall Manila" along with other progressive groups on Thursday, June 26.

The protest called for the passage of the SOGIESC Equality Bill, as well as for gender equality and economic freedom. This event continues the legacy of resistance that began with the first-ever Pride march in the Asia-Pacific in 1994. | 📷: Gabriela/Facebook via Elysa Cruz, https://t.co/E0yNJSWXKw trainee

[7:48AM] #V_Island
#TrafficUpdate

MCwen bridge moving inward Bonny camp roundabout is good though there is traffic backlog as a result of early morning high influx from Flag house.

Bonny Camp inward MCwen bridge is good to go at the moment.

Traffic is building up descending from Bonny camp bridge towards Mobil filling station due to ongoing activities at the Filling station dispensing fuel,.
Immediately after Mobil filling station, it's an appreciable vehicular movement connecting  Ahmadu Bello way enroute Eko Hotel and the return journey.

Vehicular movement from Bonny camp under-pass bridge enroute Kofo Abayomi,Oniru Kilimanjaro down to Ozunmba stretch and the return journey looks good except traffic lights delay.

The stretch of Law School enroute Civic center is moving well right now.

BJ1004 to school corner inward Sand field to Lekki phase1 and the return journey is moving steadily except delay at the alternation points.

The return journey from Lekki enroute Toll plaza down to Oriental is encouraging.

Oriental inward Sandfill down to School corner is getting busy but moving gradually  due to the early hour rush.

School Corner enroute BJ 1004 to Civic center is moving steadily.

Civic centre inward the Ramp bridge is good at the moment.
 Civic inward Law school moves fine, while law school to Akin Adeshola and Kilimanjaro is a gradual moving traffic due to traffic light delay.

Kilimanjaro to Kofo inward Bonny camp roundabout is a good moving traffic. 

#FollowLASTMA
